CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus.
   C. Say Jesus has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons
